title: A multi-omics analysis and clinical relevance of regulated cell death in bladder cancer.
snippet: Regulated cell death (RCD) is critical for tumor progression and treatment response, but its integrated role in bladder cancer remains unclear. This study aimed to systematically characterize the cross-talk, multi-omics alterations, and clinical relevance of major RCD pathways in bladder cancer. title: Effectiveness of metformin as initial treatment on the metabolic profile of Saudi patients newly diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus: A prospective observational study.
snippet: The incidence of diabetes is increasing in several countries, including Saudi Arabia. Metformin is a common treatment for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM); however, its effect on the metabolic profile of patients newly diagnosed with T2DM remains unclear.
